summary: Quantifies whether post-stimulus superior colliculus activity reflects prior-dependent shifts in perceptual choice using trial-aligned firing rates and logistic regression.
use_when: test prior-dependent modulation in superior colliculus activity
fit a choice model with contrast, prior, and neural activity
compare neurometric curves across prior conditions
quantify post-stimulus firing-rate effects on perceptual choice
estimate prior-dependent shifts in point of subjective equality
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
